checks.detail: Specified PDF rendered at 600 dpi (4959 x 7017); SHA-256 recomputed.
All 5 body rows and 9 Arabic segments were compared for visible letters and harakat; no further definite transcription defect found.
Basmala is unnumbered in this edition; the divine name in بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ retains shadda and dagger alif.
Printed markers ১–৭ remain unchanged; API ayah_ref values now apply the Surah 1 offset (printed ১ = API 1:2).
Basmala translation and all 9 Bengali body segments match the visible printed wording and continuation splits.

All 36 recorded band signs were compared for sequence, identity, conditional status, target word and horizontal placement; no further definite defect found. Oval/ring enclosures are treated as part of the sign.

definite_defects.finding: The JSON used printed Fatiha ayah numbers as API references, ignoring that API 1:1 is the basmala while this edition leaves the basmala unnumbered.
definite_defects.resolution: Corrected Arabic and Bengali segment ayah_ref values: printed ১→1:2, ২→1:3, ৩→1:4, ৪→1:5, ৫→1:6, and printed ৬–৭ content→1:7.

definite_defects.finding: Stored pdf_sha256 did not match the specified source PDF.

changes_made: Corrected 14 ayah_ref occurrences affected by the Surah 1 basmala offset.

unresolved.detail: The decorated Arabic surah title contains visible marks, but this pass does not assert a complete character-by-character title transcription.
